<!-- Auth Login Master Class -->
<script>
	document.querySelector('.copy_link_btn a').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
			e.preventDefault();
			const url = location.href.split('?')[0], cpyBtn = this;
			navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => {
					cpyBtn.querySelector(".elementor-button-text").innerHTML = 'Copied';
					cpyBtn.querySelector('.elementor-button-icon').innerHTML = `<svg width="13" height="12" viewBox="0 0 13 12" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10.5 3L5 8.5L2.5 6" stroke="currentcolor" stroke-width="1.25" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>`;
			}).catch(err => {
					console.error("Error in copy link button", err);
					cpyBtn.innerText = 'Link Copied Faild!';
			});
	});

    if(getCookie("sso_logged_in") == "true") document.querySelector(".side_container").setAttribute("loggin-status", true);
    function socialAuthSetup(){
        getFormContainer = document.querySelector(".webinar_registration_for_masterclass");
        const Config = {
            BASE_URL: "https://qa-ik-auth-service.interviewkickstart.com",
            LOGIN_EXPIRY_DAYS: 90,
            crossSubDomain: ".wpcomstaging.com", // Adjust to your domain
            sameSite: "none" // Adjust as needed: Lax, Strict, None
        };

        function setCookie(name, value, days = Config.LOGIN_EXPIRY_DAYS) {
            const maxAge = days * 24 * 60 * 60;
            document.cookie = `${name}=${value}; max-age=${maxAge}; path=/; domain=${Config.crossSubDomain}; secure; samesite=${Config.sameSite}`;
        }

        function getCookie(name) {
            const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)'));
            return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[2]) : null;
        }

        function deleteCookie(name) {
            document.cookie = `${name}=; max-age=0; path=/; domain=${Config.crossSubDomain}; secure; samesite=${Config.sameSite}`;
        }

        function clearSession() {
            deleteCookie("sso_logged_in");
            deleteCookie("sso_name");
            deleteCookie("sso_email");
            deleteCookie("access_token");
            deleteCookie("refresh_token");
        }

        /* ---------- Initiate SSO ---------- */
        const initiateSSO = async (provider) => {
            try {
                const redirect_uri = window.location.href;

                const res = await fetch(`${Config.BASE_URL}/auth/sso/${provider}/initiate/`, {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ redirect_uri }),
                });

                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`SSO failed: ${res.status}`);

                const data = await res.json();

                if (data.authorization_url) {
                    // Redirect to SSO provider
                    window.location.href = data.authorization_url;
                }else{
                    throw new Error("No authorization URL returned");
                }

            } catch (err) {
                console.error("SSO error:", err);
            }
        };

        const ssoButtons = {
            google : document.querySelectorAll(".google_btn"),
            meta : document.querySelectorAll(".meta_btn"),
            linkedin : document.querySelectorAll(".linkedin_btn"),
            // apple : document.querySelectorAll(".apple_btn")
        }
        
        for (let provider in ssoButtons) {
            ssoButtons[provider].forEach(button => {
                button.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    document.querySelector(".side_container").setAttribute("loading_status", true);
                    initiateSSO(provider);
                });
            });
        }

        function firstSignUpSessionCheck() {
            const hash = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.substring(1));

            const accessToken = hash.get("access_token");
            const refreshToken = hash.get("refresh_token");

            if (accessToken && refreshToken) {
                // store tokens in cookies
                setCookie("refresh_token", refreshToken);
                setCookie("access_token", accessToken, 15); // 15 minutes expiry
                
                const name = hash.get("full_name") || "";
                const email = hash.get("email") || "";
                
                // store session + user info
                if(!(name && email)) return;
                setCookie("sso_logged_in", "true");
                setCookie("sso_name", name || "");
                setCookie("sso_email", email || "");
                fillFildFromCookie();
            }else{
                const ssoLoggedIn = getCookie("sso_logged_in") == "true";
                const ssoName = getCookie("sso_name");
                const ssoEmail = getCookie("sso_email");
                if(ssoLoggedIn && ssoName && ssoEmail){
                    document.querySelector(".side_container").setAttribute("loggin-status", true);
                    document.querySelectorAll(".user_name").forEach(el => el.textContent = ssoName.replace(/[._-]/g, ""));
                }else{
                    document.querySelector(".side_container").setAttribute("loggin-status", false);
                }
            }
        }

        firstSignUpSessionCheck();

        function fillFildFromCookie() {
            const ssoName = getCookie("sso_name");
            const ssoEmail = getCookie("sso_email");
            if(ssoName) getFormContainer.querySelector("#Full-Name-Masterclass").value = ssoName.replace(/[._-]/g, "");
            if(ssoEmail) getFormContainer.querySelector("#Email-Address-Masterclass").value = ssoEmail;
            if(!(ssoName && ssoEmail)) return;
            document.querySelector(".side_container").setAttribute("loading_status", true);
            const sendForFirstStep = setInterval(() => {
                if(document.querySelector('[name="masterclass_slot"]:checked')?.getAttribute("data-invitee_starttime")){
                    document.querySelector(".side_container").setAttribute("loading_status", false);
                    getFormContainer.querySelector(".step_1_btn").click();
                    clearInterval(sendForFirstStep);
                }
            }, 50);

            const fromData = getCookie("mc_user_data");
            if(fromData){
                try{
                    const parsedData = JSON.parse(fromData);
                    getFormContainer.querySelector("#webinar_pnumber-Masterclass").value = parsedData.phone || "";
                    getFormContainer.querySelector("#gql_experience-Masterclass").value = parsedData.experience || "";
                    getFormContainer.querySelector("#gql_domain_role-Masterclass").value = parsedData.domain || "";
                    getFormContainer.querySelector("#gql_goal_fit-Masterclass").value = parsedData.goal || "";
                    getFormContainer.querySelector("#gql_int_select-Masterclass").value = parsedData.interview || "";

                    if(parsedData.phone && parsedData.experience && parsedData.domain){
                        document.querySelector(".side_container").setAttribute("loading_status", true);
                        let sendForSecondStep = setInterval(() => {
                            if(document.querySelector(".webinar_registration_for_masterclass").getAttribute("ac_step") != '1'){
                                getFormContainer.querySelector(".step_2_btn").click();
                                document.querySelector(".side_container").setAttribute("loading_status", false);
                                clearInterval(sendForSecondStep);
                            }
                        }, 200);

                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error("Error parsing mc_user_data cookie:", error);
                }
            }
        }

        function setSecondStepCookie(){
            const data = {
                name: getFormContainer?.querySelector("#Full-Name-Masterclass")?.value || "",
                email: getFormContainer?.querySelector("#Email-Address-Masterclass")?.value || "",
                phone: getFormContainer?.querySelector("#webinar_pnumber-Masterclass")?.value || "",
                experience: getFormContainer?.querySelector("#gql_experience-Masterclass")?.value || "",
                domain: getFormContainer?.querySelector("#gql_domain_role-Masterclass")?.value || "",
                goal: getFormContainer?.querySelector("#gql_goal_fit-Masterclass")?.value || "",
                interview: getFormContainer?.querySelector("#gql_int_select-Masterclass")?.value || ""
            };

            setCookie("mc_user_data", JSON.stringify(data));
        }

        getFormContainer.querySelector(".step_2_btn").addEventListener("click", setSecondStepCookie);
        document.querySelector(".reserved-btn").addEventListener("click", fillFildFromCookie);
        document.querySelector(".sign-diffrent-acc").addEventListener("click", function(){
            clearSession();
            document.querySelector(".side_container").setAttribute("loggin-status", false);
        });
    }
</script>
